arrival.travel_seconds: existing terrain-weighted FUR-2 path for each origin
arrival.operation_arrival: assembly deadline plus longest participant travel

combat.participant_stacks: each member and unit type remains an independent deterministic combat stack
combat.tactics: each participant tactics level modifies only that participant stack
combat.neutral_fortification: inherits pinned FUR-3 world combat rules; COMBAT-2 uses passive tier-squared structure
combat.loot_distribution: unchanged proportional surviving logistics capacity with largest-remainder member-id ties
combat.returns: each wing returns its own per-unit survivors to its origin
